text:
Raj P.: Quick heads-up: I opened a small PR with three items: a migration note for v2 SDK, a KV-prefetch example, and a clarification on quant profiles for short prompts. Would love a docs review. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489

Clara (docs): Thanks Raj. Link looks good. Can you summarize the SDK migration delta in one sentence here so I can add it to the migration guide blurb?

Raj P.: Sure 1: rename generation call signatures (Generate -> client.Generate(ctx, req) with request builder), embed param "embed_model" -> "model", and batching window moved from ms->duration type in config.

Diego (eng): Note on batching: our perf tests show interactive apps hit lower tail latency if window <=25ms. For bulk jobs 100-200ms is OK. I added a short note in examples/batching.md but please check wording.

Clara (docs): I'll reword to "recommended defaults" bullets. Also the KV prefetch example references /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet which 404s in preview. CI-bot, any link check output?

CI-bot: preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/489. Link check: 1 broken link -> /internal/prefetch-cheatsheet.

Marta R.: That internal resource was moved. Liam, can you add a relative link to the new prefetch cheatsheet or create a redirect?

Liam W.: Will do. Quick clarification: the quant short-prompt advice should suggest defaulting to fp16 when sequence < 64 and only use 4-bit if regression tests pass. Also add a short sample qprofile JSON.

Clara (docs): Draft snippet for qprofile added to the PR: ```json
{"name":"shortseq-f16","dtype":"fp16","notes":"prefer fp16 for <64 tokens"}
```

Diego (eng): Small SDK nit: the Go example used client.NewGenCall(), changed to the builder pattern. I pushed the fix.

Raj P.: Thanks. I also added a 2-line YAML showing a fallback routing policy:
```yaml
routing:
  primary: redwood/opt-2
  on_slo_violation: fallback -> redwood/opt-2-lite
```

Clara (docs): That YAML needs to match our policy schema (use 'fallback:' list). I'll tweak to valid example.

Clara (docs): Also added a short paragraph about error handling when batching exceeds SLOs, with a code sample showing a 429 handling pattern.

CI-bot: link check re-run: 0 broken links. build status: green.

Marta R.: Great. Can someone add a tiny changelog line under docs/CHANGELOG.md describing "Optimize: SDK migration notes, batching defaults, KV prefetch example, short-seq quant guidance"? Keep it one sentence.

Raj P.: I'll add the changelog entry after merge. Also leaving a note about localization for the short-seq blurb.

Liam W.: Post-merge task: update sample apps that use examples/batching to the new duration type. I'll create a small follow-up ticket.

Clara (docs): PR looks good to me. Approving. :white_check_mark:

Diego (eng): LGTM.

Marta R.: Merging. Thanks everyone!
